collection.title: Dodge Nitro 2006 to 2012 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following wiper blades will fit a Dodge Nitro 2006 - 2012 which requires a 19" wiper blade on both the drivers side and passengers side. This model uses the Hook arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm. There is also the option to upgrade to the newer Retrofit style wiper blade. We also offer a choice of rear screen wipers for this Nitro which can be viewed by clicking on the Rear Screen Wiper Blade tab below.
